newsitem.title: USA: M.Price group holds 5.7 pct Delchamps stake.
newsitem.headline: M.Price group holds 5.7 pct Delchamps stake.

text.p: A group including investor Michael Price said Friday it holds a 5.7 percent stake or 405,679 shares in Delchamps Inc.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission the group said it believes the proposed acquisition offer of $30 per share made by Jitney Jungle Stores of America "fails to adequately reflect the value" of the company's business.
The group said it "may communicate its views" to Delchamps' managers, board of directors or other shareholders.
Most recently, the Price group said it sold 37,000 shares in transactions on May 2 and June 30 at $24 and $32.35 each.
On July 8, Delchamps, a Mobile, Ala., regional supermarket chain, said it had reached an agreement with Jitney-Jungle, also a food market chain to be acquired.
At that time, Delchamps said its directors had approved of the transaction.
Delchamps operates 118 supermarkets in Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and Florida.
